description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Facts about a text that language models routinely get wrong: characters (as people see them, emoji included), words, lines, paragraphs, UTF-8 bytes, SMS segments (GSM-7 or UCS-2) and how often a word or letter appears (with positions; e.g. how many r in strawberry). Checks limits you give (max characters, words or SMS segments) before you post or send. With compareTo it returns exactly what changed between two versions (word or line diff). Deterministic, no model.

compareTo.description: another version of the text: returns what changed from compareTo to text

count.description: words, phrases or letters to count

wholeWord.description: default false: also counts inside longer words

name: text_facts
title: Exact counts, limits and differences for text
